Lists every enabled module by name in a sorted HUD panel, top right by default.
module.anarchyclient.aim_assist.descript: Smooths view movement toward valid targets without taking complete control away from the player.
module.anarchyclient.air_jump.descriptio: Lets you jump again in mid-air each time the jump key is pressed, optionally resetting fall damage.
module.anarchyclient.air_place.descripti: Places blocks, spawn eggs, armor stands, and rockets in mid-air at a set distance along your view, with a preview box.
module.anarchyclient.ambience.descriptio: Tints the whole screen with a configurable color and opacity overlay.
module.anarchyclient.anchor.description: Pulls you down and centers you while you fall over a safe obsidian or bedrock hole, helping you drop into it.
module.anarchyclient.anchor_aura.descrip: Places, charges with one glowstone, and detonates respawn anchors within reach near targets. Inactive in the Nether. Does not charge or detonate while you hold glowstone in your offhand.
module.anarchyclient.animations.descript: Applies a looping swing, slide, or spin motion to your held item, with adjustable speed and intensity.
module.anarchyclient.anti_afk.descriptio: Rotates your view and jumps at a set interval so the server does not mark you as idle.
module.anarchyclient.anti_anchor.descrip: While you crouch, places a slab between you and a respawn anchor above your head, and blocks you from using anchors yourself.
module.anarchyclient.anti_anvil.descript: Breaks anvils above your head or places obsidian under them before they land.
module.anarchyclient.anti_bed.descriptio: Breaks beds placed in your head space, fills the space around you with string, and stops you from using beds.
module.anarchyclient.anti_bot.descriptio: Removes likely bot players from your world, based on tab list, profile, game mode, ping, or invisibility checks.
module.anarchyclient.anti_cheat_detect.d: Looks for anti-cheat signals and exposes them to modules that need stricter timing or safer behavior.
module.anarchyclient.anti_crash.descript: Drops incoming explosion, particle, position, and motion packets with extreme values that could crash or freeze the client.
module.anarchyclient.anti_exploit.descri: Drops chat, title, action bar, and tab list text that is too long to render, plus custom payloads with overlong ids, optionally warning in chat.
module.anarchyclient.anti_hunger.descrip: Reduces hunger loss by hiding sprinting and other actions from the server. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.anti_packet_kick.de: Cancels outgoing movement packets with invalid coordinates or rotations and caps how many are sent per tick.
module.anarchyclient.anti_reduced_debug_: Keeps full coordinates and other F3 debug details visible on servers that enable reduced debug info.
module.anarchyclient.anti_spawnpoint.des: Cancels right-clicks on beds in the Overworld and respawn anchors in the Nether so your spawn point stays unchanged.
module.anarchyclient.anti_vanish.descrip: Compares the tab list over time and warns in chat when a player disappears without a leave message.
module.anarchyclient.anti_void.descripti: Stops your fall and holds you in place when you drop below the bottom of the world plus an offset, optionally boosting you upward.
module.anarchyclient.armor_hud.descripti: Shows your helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots with durability bars in a movable HUD panel.
module.anarchyclient.arrow_damage.descri: Sends extra sprint and movement packets when you release a bow, crossbow, or trident to boost its damage. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.arrow_dodge.descrip: Pushes you sideways when a nearby arrow is flying toward you.
module.anarchyclient.aspect.description: Scales your field of view by a set factor.
module.anarchyclient.attribute_swap.desc: Switches to the best hotbar weapon when you hit an entity and switches back on the next tick.
module.anarchyclient.auto_anvil.descript: Places an anvil above the nearest enemy or yourself so it falls on them, with an optional side support block and face trap.
module.anarchyclient.auto_armor.descript: Equips stronger armor automatically while respecting delay and replacement settings.
module.anarchyclient.auto_bed_trap.descr: Surrounds nearby beds with configured blocks such as obsidian so they cannot be used or reached.
module.anarchyclient.auto_bow.descriptio: Aims your drawn bow at the closest target with projectile drop compensation and releases it once charged.
module.anarchyclient.auto_breed.descript: Feeds the nearest adult animal with matching food from your hotbar, once per breeding cycle.
module.anarchyclient.auto_brewer.descrip: Moves fuel, nether wart, and water bottles into an open brewing stand between brews and takes out the brewed potions.
module.anarchyclient.auto_buff.descripti: Throws strength, speed, or regeneration potions at your feet, or drinks them when Splash is off, when the effect is missing.
module.anarchyclient.auto_city.descripti: Mines the obsidian or ender chest blocks that surround the nearest enemy, including a burrow block.
module.anarchyclient.auto_clicker.descri: Attacks or uses items at a randomized CPS, optionally only while the button is held with a weapon.
module.anarchyclient.auto_config.descrip: Applies safer module presets after server detection and can disable risky modules when checks look unstable.
module.anarchyclient.auto_craft.descript: Crafts the configured items from your recipe book in an open crafting table and collects or drops the result.
module.anarchyclient.auto_disable.descri: Turns off a configured list of modules when you die, disconnect, or get a server setback.
module.anarchyclient.auto_drop.descripti: Drops configured items from your inventory, with an option to include the hotbar.
module.anarchyclient.auto_enchant.descri: Enchants configured items at the chosen level in an open enchanting table, refilling lapis and collecting results.
module.anarchyclient.auto_extinguish.des: Puts out fire blocks within reach and can pour a water bucket at your feet when you are burning.
module.anarchyclient.auto_farm.descripti: Harvests mature crops and can replant, bone meal, and till soil around you.
module.anarchyclient.auto_fish.descripti: Reels in the fishing rod when a fish bites and casts it again after a short delay.
module.anarchyclient.auto_gg.description: Sends a configured chat message when you die, with a cooldown between messages.
module.anarchyclient.auto_grind.descript: Moves items with removable enchantments into an open grindstone and collects the disenchanted output.
module.anarchyclient.auto_jump.descripti: Jumps whenever you are on the ground, optionally only while moving and not in water or lava.
module.anarchyclient.auto_log.descriptio: Disconnects you when health drops too low, totems pop, an unfriended player comes close, or crystals and TNT gather nearby.
module.anarchyclient.auto_login.descript: Sends a configured login command a set time after joining, chosen by server address, name, or a fallback entry.
module.anarchyclient.auto_mend.descripti: Swaps your most damaged mending item into the offhand until collected XP fully repairs it. Leaves the offhand alone while a totem protects low health or Auto Totem is using it.
module.anarchyclient.auto_mount.descript: Mounts the nearest free horse, camel, boat, minecart, or saddled pig or strider in range.
module.anarchyclient.auto_nametag.descri: Uses a renamed name tag from the hotbar on the nearest unnamed mob within range.
module.anarchyclient.auto_pot.descriptio: Drinks or throws healing and strength potions when health or effect conditions make them useful.
module.anarchyclient.auto_queue.descript: Sends a configured command, such as /play, when a chat message contains the trigger text.
module.anarchyclient.auto_reconnect.desc: Reconnects to the last server after a disconnect, except when Auto Log disconnected you.
module.anarchyclient.auto_rename.descrip: Renames items in an open anvil to a set name, or labels shulkers and bundles after their first item, and takes the results.
module.anarchyclient.auto_replenish.desc: Refills low hotbar stacks from matching stacks in the main inventory when they drop to the threshold.
module.anarchyclient.auto_respawn.descri: Respawns you automatically after death once the configured delay has passed.
module.anarchyclient.auto_shearer.descri: Shears the nearest sheep or other shearable mob in range with shears from the hotbar.
module.anarchyclient.auto_shoot.descript: Turns toward the nearest target in range, then throws snowballs, eggs, pearls, experience bottles, or casts a fishing rod once aimed.
module.anarchyclient.auto_shop.descripti: Quick-moves configured items out of open container menus, such as server shop GUIs, on a fixed delay.
module.anarchyclient.auto_sign.descripti: Writes the configured four lines to each sign you place instead of opening the sign editor.
module.anarchyclient.auto_smelter.descri: Takes furnace output, then loads coal or charcoal as fuel and smeltable inventory items as input in an open furnace.
module.anarchyclient.auto_sprint.descrip: Keeps sprinting active when movement conditions allow it.
module.anarchyclient.auto_tnt.descriptio: Ignites nearby TNT with flint and steel or fire charges, skipping lighters that are close to breaking.
module.anarchyclient.auto_tool.descripti: Switches to the fastest correct hotbar tool for the block you are mining, skipping tools about to break.
module.anarchyclient.auto_totem.descript: Keeps a totem ready in the offhand by scoring danger, inventory state, and configured replacement rules.
module.anarchyclient.auto_trap.descripti: Places hard blocks around the nearest enemy's head, or your own, to box them in, with optional feet and anti-step layers.
module.anarchyclient.auto_walk.descripti: Holds the forward or backward key for you, with optional sprinting and a stop when you hit a wall.
module.anarchyclient.auto_wasp.descripti: Flies you toward the nearest enemy player by setting your velocity in their direction each tick.
module.anarchyclient.auto_weapon.descrip: Selects the best available weapon before attacks using damage, enchantment, and item checks.
module.anarchyclient.auto_web.descriptio: Places cobwebs at the feet or head of the nearest non-friend player in range, or on yourself.
module.anarchyclient.auto_wind_charge.de: Looks straight down and fires a wind charge once you fall farther than the set distance, to break the fall.
module.anarchyclient.auto_wither.descrip: Finds open space nearby and builds a wither from soul sand or soul soil and wither skeleton skulls, with a build preview.
module.anarchyclient.avoid_hazards.descr: Stops your movement when you are about to walk into lava, fire, cactus, berry bushes, wither roses, or powder snow. You can still walk out once inside one.
module.anarchyclient.backtrack.descripti: Delays entity movement updates while an enemy is in range, so you can still hit where they were a moment ago.
module.anarchyclient.bed_aura.descriptio: Places and detonates beds within reach near targets outside the Overworld. Damage values are in HP.
module.anarchyclient.bed_plates.descript: Outlines beds, including straw beds, within range with cyan boxes.
module.anarchyclient.better_beacons.desc: Adds beacon payment items, range per tier, and unlockable effects to the beacon item tooltip.
module.anarchyclient.better_chat.descrip: Adds timestamps to chat, merges repeated messages into one line with a count, keeps chat across disconnects, and can append a suffix to sent messages.
module.anarchyclient.better_inventory.de: Adds stack size and remaining durability percentage lines to item tooltips.
module.anarchyclient.better_tab.descript: Sorts and filters the player list and marks entries with ping, game mode, and highlights for you, friends, and staff.
module.anarchyclient.better_tooltips.des: Adds durability, container contents, and potion effects to item tooltips.
module.anarchyclient.blink.description: Holds back your movement packets and sends them together when disabled, so the server sees you jump to the new position.
module.anarchyclient.block_in.descriptio: Snaps you to the block center and surrounds you with blocks on all sides and overhead, then turns off when done.
module.anarchyclient.block_outline.descr: Draws a cyan box with optional fill around the targeted block, optionally visible through other blocks.
module.anarchyclient.block_selection.des: Draws a cyan outline, with optional fill, around the block you are looking at.
module.anarchyclient.blur.description: Blurs the world behind inventories, containers, and other in-game screens using the vanilla Menu Background Blur strength.
module.anarchyclient.boat_glitch.descrip: Periodically sends a raised vehicle position followed by the real one while riding, to glitch the boat on the server.
module.anarchyclient.boat_phase.descript: Disables collision on your ridden vehicle and steers it with movement, jump, and sneak keys so it passes through blocks.
module.anarchyclient.book_bot.descriptio: Writes the configured pages into a writable book from your hands or hotbar, optionally signs it, and can repeat.
module.anarchyclient.boost.description: Pushes you forward in your look direction once, or repeatedly on a timer with Auto Boost.
module.anarchyclient.boss_stack.descript: Lists boss bars received while enabled with their names and progress percentages.
module.anarchyclient.bounce.description: Launches you upward again each time you touch the ground, unless you are sneaking.
module.anarchyclient.bow_aimbot.descript: Aims at the nearest player or hostile in range while you draw a bow or hold a loaded crossbow, leading the target and compensating for arrow drop.
module.anarchyclient.bow_spam.descriptio: Releases a drawn bow after a set number of charge ticks so you fire arrows rapidly.
module.anarchyclient.breadcrumbs.descrip: Draws a line through walls along your recent path, dropping points older than the set lifetime.
module.anarchyclient.break_delay.descrip: Sets the vanilla right-click repeat delay, so held use actions such as placing blocks repeat faster.
module.anarchyclient.break_indicators.de: Shows red boxes on blocks being mined that grow with break progress.
module.anarchyclient.build_height.descri: Warns you in chat when you get within the set distance of the world's build height limit.
module.anarchyclient.bungeecord_spoof.de: Adds a forwarded IP, your UUID, and optionally your profile properties such as your skin to the login handshake so BungeeCord-mode backend servers accept a direct connection.
module.anarchyclient.burrow.description: Centers you, jumps, and places a block in the space you stood in, then sends a raised position to lag you back into it.
module.anarchyclient.chams.description: Draws see-through boxes around players and, optionally, hostile mobs within range.
module.anarchyclient.chat_bot.descriptio: Replies in chat when a message contains the prefix and a configured keyword, filling in placeholders like player name and coordinates.
module.anarchyclient.chat_spammer.descri: Sends configured chat messages on a timer with optional formatting and variation.
module.anarchyclient.chest_aura.descript: Opens nearby chests, barrels, and other listed containers automatically, skipping ones already opened and optionally closing the ones it opened.
module.anarchyclient.chest_cleaner.descr: Throws configured junk items out of an open chest one slot at a time with a short delay.
module.anarchyclient.chest_stealer.descr: Shift-clicks items out of an open chest into the inventory, skipping ignored items, and closes the chest once it is empty.
module.anarchyclient.chest_swap.descript: Swaps between an elytra and the best chestplate in the chest slot, then turns itself off.
module.anarchyclient.chorus_exploit.desc: Holds back the teleport from a chorus fruit and accepts it after a delay, drawing a line to the pending destination.
module.anarchyclient.city_esp.descriptio: Outlines obsidian, anchors, and ender chests directly beside nearby players, showing which blocks can be mined to city them.
module.anarchyclient.click_tp.descriptio: Teleports on top of the targeted block when you middle-click, optionally only while sneaking. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.collisions.descript: Turns off client-side block collision so the player can move through blocks the server allows.
module.anarchyclient.color_signs.descrip: Converts & color codes into formatting codes when you write signs and, optionally, books. Vanilla servers strip sign formatting, so signs only keep colors on servers that allow it.
module.anarchyclient.combat_hud.descript: Shows the nearest non-friend player with distance and health, plus your health and totem, crystal, and XP bottle counts.
module.anarchyclient.compass_hud.descrip: Shows the facing direction, yaw in degrees, and a small N E S W compass strip.
module.anarchyclient.coord_logger.descri: Logs distant player and tamed wolf teleports to chat. Global events like wither spawns show their direction, because the server only sends the exact position within 32 blocks.
module.anarchyclient.coordinates_hud.des: Shows your coordinates, linked Nether or Overworld coordinates outside the End, dimension, facing, speed, FPS, and ping.
module.anarchyclient.criticals.descripti: Times attack packets or movement so melee hits can register as critical hits.
module.anarchyclient.crosshair.descripti: Draws a plus-shaped crosshair at the screen center with adjustable arm size and gap.
module.anarchyclient.crystal_aura.descri: Places and breaks end crystals within reach near targets. Damage values are in HP and skip crystals that would kill you.
module.anarchyclient.custom_packets.desc: Reports custom payload packets from the server, such as the server brand, in chat and the log with an optional filter.
module.anarchyclient.damage_particles.de: Spawns damage indicator particles on any entity that takes damage.
module.anarchyclient.debug_recorder.desc: Records recent packet names and saves them to a log file when disabled or when the server flags you.
module.anarchyclient.debug_render.descri: Outlines your own hitbox and the current chunk boundary around your height.
module.anarchyclient.discord_presence.de: Updates Discord Rich Presence with configurable client and server status.
module.anarchyclient.eagle.description: Sneaks automatically at block edges so you do not walk off while bridging.
module.anarchyclient.easy_pearl.descript: Throws an ender pearl from either hand at a set pitch with one keypress, then turns itself off.
module.anarchyclient.echest_farmer.descr: Places an ender chest in front of you and mines it with a non-Silk Touch pickaxe to farm obsidian.
module.anarchyclient.elytra_boost.descri: Pushes you forward in the look direction while gliding with an elytra and holding the forward key.
module.anarchyclient.elytra_fly.descript: Controls elytra flight speed and height directly from movement keys, with optional auto start when falling while wearing a usable elytra.
module.anarchyclient.elytra_recast.descr: Resends the elytra start packet while airborne so gliding restarts after it stops.
module.anarchyclient.elytra_swap.descrip: Equips an elytra from the inventory when you fall more than two blocks while wearing something else in the chest slot.
module.anarchyclient.enderman_look.descr: Tilts your view to a set pitch when you look at an enderman within 64 blocks so it does not turn hostile.
module.anarchyclient.entity_owner.descri: Outlines every tamed animal that has an owner through walls and labels nearby ones with the owner's name.
module.anarchyclient.esp.description: Outlines players and mobs through walls with boxes or a shader glow, colored by type or distance.
module.anarchyclient.excavator.descripti: Mines nearby blocks from the configured list automatically within a set radius, one block at a time unless they break instantly.
module.anarchyclient.exp_thrower.descrip: Throws XP bottles from the hotbar whenever any worn armor piece drops below the durability threshold.
module.anarchyclient.extra_elytra.descri: Starts gliding instantly on jump and adds speed and height control with movement keys while flying.
module.anarchyclient.fake_lag.descriptio: Holds back outgoing movement packets and releases them after a delay, making you appear to lag to other players.
module.anarchyclient.fake_player.descrip: Spawns a client-side copy of your player with your equipment for testing combat modules.
module.anarchyclient.fast_climb.descript: Climbs ladders and vines faster while holding the forward key.
module.anarchyclient.fast_exp.descriptio: Throws experience bottles at your feet to repair mending armor, up to a set number of throws until the armor is repaired.
module.anarchyclient.fast_place.descript: Removes the right-click delay for blocks and, optionally, XP bottles and crystals. Turn off Blocks Only to remove it for every item.
module.anarchyclient.fast_use.descriptio: Removes the right-click delay for all items or a chosen item list.
module.anarchyclient.flag_check.descript: Detects server lagbacks and forced rotations, records them, and alerts you in chat.
module.anarchyclient.flag_timeline_hud.d: Shows the anti-cheat flag count, the last flag reason, velocity corrections, and tab list joins and leaves.
module.anarchyclient.flamethrower.descri: Sets fire to the tops of nearby blocks with flint and steel or fire charges, never right next to you.
module.anarchyclient.flight.description: Provides configurable flight movement for creative-style travel or server-specific modes.
module.anarchyclient.free_look.descripti: Lets you rotate the camera independently of the player's facing direction.
module.anarchyclient.freecam.description: Detaches the camera from the player so areas can be inspected without moving the body.
module.anarchyclient.fullbright.descript: Raises scene brightness so caves and night areas stay readable without torches.
module.anarchyclient.gamemode_notifier.d: Sends a chat message when a player switches to one of the selected gamemodes.
module.anarchyclient.ghost_hand.descript: Cancels right-clicks on grass, vines, snow, and other listed blocks.
module.anarchyclient.ghost_mode.descript: Keeps the death screen from closing and holds client health above zero until the module is turned off.
module.anarchyclient.glide.description: Caps your fall speed in the air so you drift down slowly, optionally only above open space.
module.anarchyclient.hand_view.descripti: Scales, shifts, or hides the first-person held item and hand.
module.anarchyclient.high_jump.descripti: Sets a higher upward velocity when you jump from the ground so you clear taller obstacles.
module.anarchyclient.highway_builder.des: Places blocks under the path ahead of you to pave a highway, with optional side rails.
module.anarchyclient.hit_fx.description: Spawns a burst of critical-hit particles on each entity you attack.
module.anarchyclient.hitbox.description: Enlarges living entity hitboxes for your crosshair and adds the same extra range to client targeting.
module.anarchyclient.hole_esp.descriptio: Highlights nearby one-block holes fully walled by bedrock, obsidian, or other blast-proof blocks.
module.anarchyclient.hole_filler.descrip: Fills nearby safe holes and double holes with hard blocks, by default only near an enemy.
module.anarchyclient.hole_hud.descriptio: Shows whether bedrock, obsidian, or other blast-proof blocks surround you on all four sides and below.
module.anarchyclient.infinity_miner.desc: Mines the closest listed blocks around you automatically, such as stone, deepslate, and netherrack.
module.anarchyclient.instant_rebreak.des: After you mine a block, breaks it again instantly each time a block reappears at that spot. Uses the item in your hand.
module.anarchyclient.interaction_menu.de: Copies the target's info, sends a command, or adds a friend when you middle click a target.
module.anarchyclient.inventory_cleaner.d: Drops junk items, or in strict mode everything except your best gear and kept item types.
module.anarchyclient.inventory_hud.descr: Shows your main inventory and hotbar as an item grid on screen.
module.anarchyclient.inventory_move.desc: Lets you walk, jump, and sneak while an inventory or other screen is open.
module.anarchyclient.inventory_tracker.d: Records the held items, armor, and health of nearby players. View them with /ac inventory [player].
module.anarchyclient.item_generator.desc: Fills your selected hotbar slot with a new random item at a set interval in creative mode.
module.anarchyclient.item_highlight.desc: Highlights dropped items from your list or a valuable filter, and can mark end crystals.
module.anarchyclient.item_hud.descriptio: Shows the items in your main hand and offhand on screen.
module.anarchyclient.item_physics.descri: Renders dropped items flat, spinning, or bobbing, and can stop them falling on your client until turned off.
module.anarchyclient.item_tags.descripti: Labels dropped items with name, count, and distance, and adds registry IDs to tooltips.
module.anarchyclient.jesus.description: Pushes you up out of water and lava so you can float, glide, or bounce across the surface.
module.anarchyclient.jetpack.description: Lifts you upward at a set speed while you hold jump. It does not prevent fall damage; use No Fall for that.
module.anarchyclient.jump_effect.descrip: Shows a brief marker at your feet each time you jump.
module.anarchyclient.keep_sprint.descrip: Keeps your sprint and speed after a sprint hit instead of slowing down.
module.anarchyclient.kill_aura.descripti: Attacks selected targets automatically with configurable targeting, timing, rotation, and safety checks.
module.anarchyclient.knockback_plus.desc: Sends a sprint packet before each attack so your hits deal sprint knockback, then restores your real sprint state on the next tick.
module.anarchyclient.lag_notifier_hud.de: Shows how long the server has sent no packets, by default only past a set threshold.
module.anarchyclient.lavacast.descriptio: Alternates lava and water buckets on the block you look at to build a lavacast.
module.anarchyclient.lawn_bot.descriptio: Replaces nearby mycelium, podzol, and other dirt variants with grass blocks from your hotbar.
module.anarchyclient.light_overlay.descr: Marks nearby blocks with a red cross where light is low enough for mobs to spawn.
module.anarchyclient.liquid_filler.descr: Places blocks into nearby water and lava source blocks, preferring dry sponges when enabled and falling back to other blocks.
module.anarchyclient.liquid_interact.des: Lets you place blocks against water and lava surfaces you are looking at.
module.anarchyclient.logout_spots.descri: Marks the position where nearby players were standing when they logged out.
module.anarchyclient.long_jump.descripti: Launches you forward in one long jump when you move, then turns off after landing.
module.anarchyclient.mace_kill.descripti: Attacks the closest target with your mace after a long enough fall at full attack charge.
module.anarchyclient.macros.description: Runs configured chat or command actions from keybind-style triggers.
module.anarchyclient.map_hud.description: Shows a minimap of nearby entities with your heading, chunk coordinates, and biome.
module.anarchyclient.message_aura.descri: Sends a chat message to each player who comes within range, with a cooldown per player.
module.anarchyclient.middle_click_action: Throws a pearl or XP bottle, runs a command, or adds a friend on middle click.
module.anarchyclient.module_info_hud.des: Shows how many modules are enabled in total and in each category.
module.anarchyclient.more_carry.descript: Keeps items in your crafting grid by not telling the server you closed your inventory.
module.anarchyclient.moss_bot.descriptio: Bone meals moss blocks with the most moss-replaceable blocks nearby to spread moss.
module.anarchyclient.multi_actions.descr: Lets you attack, break, and place blocks while eating or using an item.
module.anarchyclient.name_collector.desc: Collects the names of online players and adds them to a per-server file when you leave or turn it off.
module.anarchyclient.name_protect.descri: Replaces your name, and optionally friend or listed names, in chat and the tab list.
module.anarchyclient.nametags.descriptio: Shows the name, distance, and health of nearby players above their heads or in a list on screen.
module.anarchyclient.new_chunks.descript: Marks chunks where flowing liquid updates next to a source block, which suggests freshly generated terrain, in red. Marks reset when you change dimension or server.
module.anarchyclient.no_block_interact.d: Blocks right-click use on listed or unlisted blocks, such as chests and furnaces, for the chosen hand.
Blocks right-click use on chosen entity types, such as armor stands and item frames, optionally only with certain held items.
module.anarchyclient.no_fall.description: Prevents fall damage by telling the server the player is on the ground while falling. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.no_ghost_blocks.des: Sends an aborted dig for the block you look at so servers that resend it can fix a ghost block. Vanilla servers do not resend blocks for this.
module.anarchyclient.no_interact.descrip: Cancels selected block use, mining, item use, and entity use or attacks, with extra filters for friends, babies, and named mobs.
module.anarchyclient.no_jump_delay.descr: Removes the short delay between jumps when holding the jump key.
module.anarchyclient.no_mining_trace.des: Lets block clicks pass through entities in the way so the block behind them gets mined or used.
module.anarchyclient.no_miss_cooldown.de: Removes the short attack cooldown that vanilla adds after you click at air, so you can attack again right away.
module.anarchyclient.no_push.description: Stops other entities, and optionally water and lava currents, from pushing the player around.
module.anarchyclient.no_render.descripti: Suppresses selected visual effects, overlays, and entities that clutter the screen.
module.anarchyclient.no_rotate_set.descr: Ignores server packets that force the camera rotation, and optionally the rotation in position corrections.
module.anarchyclient.no_slot_set.descrip: Ignores server packets that change the selected hotbar slot and keeps the server on your slot.
module.anarchyclient.no_slow.description: Keeps full movement speed while eating, drawing bows, or blocking, and ignores slowdown from webs, honey, soul sand, and similar blocks.
module.anarchyclient.no_slow_break.descr: Removes Mining Fatigue on the client only. The server still applies it, so on most servers broken blocks reappear as ghost blocks until the server finishes them.
module.anarchyclient.no_swing.descriptio: Hides your own hand swing animation. With Server Side on, also stops the swing packet for missed attacks from reaching the server.
module.anarchyclient.no_web.description: Lets the player pass through cobwebs without slowdown, or steer inside them at a set speed.
module.anarchyclient.notebot.description: Plays configured note patterns through note blocks or sound actions. Pauses in creative mode, where hitting a note block breaks it.
module.anarchyclient.notifier.descriptio: Posts chat messages when players join or leave, enter or leave visual range, or pop totems.
module.anarchyclient.nuker.description: Breaks blocks around the player in a sphere, cube, or floor shape, with allow and deny lists. Legit mines one block at a time; Packet only breaks blocks the server accepts in one tick.
module.anarchyclient.nyan_cat_gif_spamme: Shows an animated Nyan Cat GIF at a random spot on your screen at random intervals. Only you can see it.
module.anarchyclient.obsidian_farm.descr: Mines nearby obsidian with a diamond or netherite pickaxe and stops after breaking the block underfoot until you reach the Nether.
module.anarchyclient.ore_sim.description: Outlines the height band where the selected ore generates in its dimension and marks its most common layer. It does not predict exact ore positions.
module.anarchyclient.packet_canceller.de: Drops incoming or outgoing packets whose names match the configured filters.
module.anarchyclient.packet_debug_hud.de: Shows packet queue sizes, timer state, balance values, and module debug values.
module.anarchyclient.packet_fly.descript: Uses packet movement to handle flight-like movement on servers where normal movement is restricted.
module.anarchyclient.packet_logger.descr: Records packet traffic for debugging protocol behavior and module interactions.
module.anarchyclient.packet_mine.descrip: Breaks the block under the crosshair instantly with start and stop mining packets after a set delay. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.painter.description: Places a chosen block, such as buttons, on nearby top, side, or bottom surfaces.
module.anarchyclient.parkour.description: Jumps automatically when walking forward off the edge of a block.
module.anarchyclient.payload_inspector.d: Shows custom payload traffic so plugin channels and server messages are easier to debug.
module.anarchyclient.ping_spoof.descript: Delays keep-alive and ping replies to make the connection look slower to the server.
module.anarchyclient.player_model_hud.de: Shows a small panel with your player model that follows the mouse.
module.anarchyclient.player_radar_hud.de: Lists nearby players with their distance and health, closest first, and marks friends.
module.anarchyclient.plugin_scanner.desc: Inspects server plugin hints from available commands, messages, and protocol details.
module.anarchyclient.pop_chams.descripti: Draws a fading outline that floats up where an entity pops a totem.
module.anarchyclient.portal_menu.descrip: Lets you open and use menus and chat while standing in a nether portal.
module.anarchyclient.potion_saver.descri: Blocks drinking a potion when you already have all of its effects at the same or a higher level and duration.
module.anarchyclient.potion_timers_hud.d: Lists active potion effects with their level and remaining time.
module.anarchyclient.projectile_aimbot.d: Leads projectile shots toward selected targets with configurable range and aim rules.
Hits fireballs, wind charges, and shulker bullets that fly toward you within range to deflect or destroy them.
module.anarchyclient.protection_zones.de: Draws boxes around saved coordinate centers to mark protected areas.
module.anarchyclient.quiver.description: While you hold use with a bow, releases it after a set number of draw ticks and draws it again right away.
module.anarchyclient.radar_hud.descripti: Shows a top-down radar with dots for nearby players, hostile and passive mobs, and items.
module.anarchyclient.reach.description: Extends block and entity interaction range by a set number of blocks. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.rendering.descripti: Adjusts FOV and camera offsets and removes hurt camera, view bobbing, blindness, darkness, and chosen status effects.
module.anarchyclient.reverse_step.descri: Pulls the player down faster when walking off ledges. Ignores jumps, flight, and elytra gliding.
module.anarchyclient.robo_walk.descripti: Rounds sent player and vehicle positions to a fixed grid on the X and Z axes.
module.anarchyclient.rotation.descriptio: Locks your player to a fixed yaw and pitch, so you look, walk, and hit in that direction.
module.anarchyclient.safe_walk.descripti: Stops the player from walking off block edges, optionally only while sneaking or holding blocks.
module.anarchyclient.scaffold.descriptio: Places blocks under the player while walking, with optional tower, sprint, and edge protection.
module.anarchyclient.server_fingerprint_: Shows the detected server type, anti-cheat, TPS, safety score, plugins, and payload channels.
module.anarchyclient.server_observer.des: Tracks server identity, brand, and connection details so other modules can adapt to the current server.
module.anarchyclient.server_spoof.descri: Hides client details from the server by spoofing the handshake host and brand, blocking mod channels, and faking resource pack loading.
module.anarchyclient.shield_bypass.descr: Hits a shielding target from behind by briefly sending a position past its shield. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.silent_disconnect.d: Skips the disconnect screen after a kick and shows the kick reason as a toast instead.
module.anarchyclient.silent_hotbar.descr: Shows the selected slot and which module holds a silent switch, and can hold a chosen slot.
module.anarchyclient.skeleton_esp.descri: Draws stick-figure skeletons over nearby players through walls, with friends shown in blue.
module.anarchyclient.slippy.description: Multiplies your ground speed each tick while you walk, so movement slides like on ice.
module.anarchyclient.smart_eat.descripti: Eats until the item is consumed when hunger or health is low, choosing food by quality and combat pressure.
module.anarchyclient.smooth_camera.descr: Turns on the vanilla cinematic camera so mouse movement is smoothed out.
module.anarchyclient.sneak.description: Holds sneak for you, with options to pause in menus, in liquids, while airborne, or while gliding.
module.anarchyclient.sound_blocker.descr: Cancels selected server sounds, including entity sounds and the sound of explosions that do not push you.
module.anarchyclient.sound_locator.descr: Marks where server sounds play with boxes, optionally filtered by sound ID and logged to chat.
module.anarchyclient.spawn_proofer.descr: Places torches from your hotbar on dark, solid blocks around you so mobs cannot spawn there.
module.anarchyclient.speed.description: Sets your horizontal movement speed, with ground, low hop, bunny hop, and collision safe modes.
module.anarchyclient.speed_mine.descript: Mines blocks faster by sending the finish-digging packet early, or by repeated legit breaking. Packet mode never stops before 70% progress, the earliest point the server accepts.
module.anarchyclient.spider.description: Lets you climb up walls by pushing you upward whenever you walk into a block.
module.anarchyclient.staff_alert.descrip: Warns in chat when a known or staff-like player joins or comes near, and can disable listed modules.
module.anarchyclient.stash_finder.descri: Scans loaded chunks for clusters of chests and other containers and reports possible stashes in chat.
module.anarchyclient.step.description: Raises your step height so you walk up full blocks or more without jumping.
module.anarchyclient.storage_esp.descrip: Highlights storage blocks in the world so chests, shulkers, and similar containers are easier to find.
module.anarchyclient.strafe.description: Lets you steer freely in the air by setting your midair velocity toward the keys you hold. Does nothing while flying or gliding.
module.anarchyclient.stronghold_finder.d: Estimates the stronghold position from the flight paths of two thrown eyes of ender and prints it in chat.
module.anarchyclient.super_knockback.des: Sends a stop and start sprint packet before each hit while you sprint, so the server applies sprint knockback.
module.anarchyclient.surround.descriptio: Places obsidian or ender chests around your feet, with optional floor, second layer, and wider ring.
module.anarchyclient.swarm.description: Connects clients over a socket so a host can make workers send the same chat messages or commands.
module.anarchyclient.sword_block.descrip: Raises a shield from your offhand or hotbar when you right-click while holding a weapon.
module.anarchyclient.target_lock.descrip: Keeps combat modules on the same target by locking onto the nearest player until it leaves range.
module.anarchyclient.target_strafe.descr: Circles around the nearest enemy at a set radius while you move, and can jump to keep speed.
module.anarchyclient.teams.description: Prevents combat modules from targeting players that match configured team checks.
Masks text fields with asterisks when their label or text matches password, login, or custom patterns.
module.anarchyclient.text_hud.descriptio: Shows lines of custom text that you write on the HUD, one entry per line.
module.anarchyclient.tick_base.descripti: Shifts queued player actions across ticks for burst movement or combat timing.
module.anarchyclient.time_changer.descri: Freezes the visible time of day at a chosen value on your client and restores the server time when disabled.
module.anarchyclient.timer.description: Speeds up or slows down the client game tick rate. This can flag anti-cheats.
module.anarchyclient.timer_range.descrip: Adjusts timer speed around nearby targets so timing changes stay tied to combat range.
module.anarchyclient.tnt_timer.descripti: Shows the remaining fuse time above primed TNT and outlines it in colors that turn red near explosion.
module.anarchyclient.tracers.description: Draws lines from your view to nearby players and mobs, colored by entity type and friend status.
module.anarchyclient.trail.description: Draws a line along the recent path of each nearby player until the points expire or you change dimension.
module.anarchyclient.trajectories.descri: Draws the predicted flight path of the projectile you hold and of thrown items and arrows already in the air.
module.anarchyclient.tree_aura.descripti: Plants saplings on open dirt around you and grows them with bone meal from your hotbar.
module.anarchyclient.trident_boost.descr: Pushes you in your look direction each tick while you charge a trident.
module.anarchyclient.true_sight.descript: Outlines invisible players and mobs near you so you can see where they are.
module.anarchyclient.tunnel_esp.descript: Outlines one-wide, two-tall tunnel spaces near you, such as paths dug by other players.
module.anarchyclient.vehicle_boost.descr: Pushes your vehicle forward in your look direction while you hold the forward key.
module.anarchyclient.vehicle_control.des: Steers your vehicle with your movement keys at a set speed and can move it up and down with jump and sneak.
module.anarchyclient.vehicle_one_hit.des: Sends extra attack packets when you hit a boat or minecart so it breaks in one hit.
module.anarchyclient.vein_miner.descript: When a block you mine breaks, also breaks connected blocks of the same type that you can break instantly, up to a set limit.
module.anarchyclient.velocity.descriptio: Reduces, cancels, or reverses the knockback you take from hits and explosions, with an optional jump reset mode.
module.anarchyclient.void_esp.descriptio: Draws a red plane at a set height around you to mark where the void or a dangerous drop starts.
module.anarchyclient.wall_hack.descripti: Highlights selected blocks such as diamond ore, ancient debris, and spawners through walls.
module.anarchyclient.waypoints.descripti: Renders saved locations with labels and distance cues so routes are easier to follow.
module.anarchyclient.weather_changer.des: Sets client-side weather to clear, rain, or thunder regardless of the server weather, and restores the server weather when turned off.
module.anarchyclient.xray.description: Highlights the selected blocks through terrain, nearest first, up to the configured count.
module.anarchyclient.yggdrasil_signature: Warns in chat when the server sends player skins without a valid Yggdrasil signature. Vanilla can show the default skin for those players.
module.anarchyclient.zoom.description: Narrows your rendered field of view by a set factor to zoom in. Your FOV option is not changed.
setting.anarchyclient.anti_exploit.max_p: Longest chat, title, action bar, or tab list text to show, in characters.
setting.anarchyclient.anti_hunger.keep_f: Sends grounded movement as airborne. Lets a grounded packet through before the server's fall distance can hurt you. This can flag anti-cheats.
setting.anarchyclient.anti_hunger.no_spr: Hides sprinting from the server. This can flag anti-cheats.
setting.anarchyclient.auto_enchant.items: Comma-separated item ids. Empty enchants any enchantable item.
setting.anarchyclient.auto_rename.name: Name
setting.anarchyclient.auto_shop.buy_item: Comma-separated item ids to quick-move from shop menus.
setting.anarchyclient.better_chat.anti_c: Keeps chat history when you disconnect or switch servers. F3+D still clears chat.
setting.anarchyclient.better_tab.hide_re: Regex for names to hide from the tab overlay.
setting.anarchyclient.book_bot.title: Title
setting.anarchyclient.bungeecord_spoof.s: Comma-separated host fragments. Empty matches all.
setting.anarchyclient.fake_player.name: Name
setting.anarchyclient.free_look.lock_pla: When on, the mouse turns only the camera. When off, the mouse turns both, but the camera ignores rotations from other modules.
setting.anarchyclient.name_protect.names: Extra names to protect, separated by commas or spaces.
setting.anarchyclient.no_rotate_set.posi: Keeps your view after server position corrections. The correction itself still applies.
setting.anarchyclient.no_swing.server_si: Stops swing packets for missed attacks from reaching the server.
setting.anarchyclient.notebot.song.descr: Whitespace/comma separated notes. Use + for chords and tick:note for explicit ticks.
setting.anarchyclient.protection_zones.z: Centers as x,y,z entries separated by semicolons.
setting.anarchyclient.shield_bypass.igno: Do not bypass when holding an axe.
setting.anarchyclient.staff_alert.staff_: Extra staff names, separated by commas or spaces.
setting.anarchyclient.text_field_protect: Comma-separated field labels or regex patterns to mask while rendering.
